#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

const int mod = 998244353;

int mod_mul(int a, int b) { return (ll)a * b % mod; }
int mod_add(int a, int b) { a += b; if (a >= mod) a -= mod; return a; }
int mod_sub(int a, int b) { a -= b; if (a < 0) a += mod; return a; }

int mod_pow(int a, int e) {
    int res = 1;
    while (e) {
        if (e & 1) res = (ll)res * a % mod;
        a = (ll)a * a % mod;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int mod_inv(int a) { return mod_pow(a, mod - 2); }

// NTT primes and primitive roots
const int NTTPrimes[] = {1053818881, 1051721729, 1045430273, 1012924417, 1007681537, 1004535809, 998244353, 985661441, 976224257, 975175681};
const int NTTPrimitiveRoots[] = {7, 6, 3, 5, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 17};

vector<int> ntt(vector<int> a, bool invert, int P, int g) {
    int n = (int)a.size();
    for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int bit = n >> 1;
        for (; j & bit; bit >>= 1) j ^= bit;
        j ^= bit;
        if (i < j) swap(a[i], a[j]);
    }
    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        int wlen = mod_pow(g, (P - 1) / len);
        if (invert) wlen = mod_inv(wlen);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            int w = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < len / 2; j++) {
                int u = a[i + j];
                int v = (ll)a[i + j + len / 2] * w % P;
                a[i + j] = (u + v) % P;
                a[i + j + len / 2] = (u - v + P) % P;
                w = (ll)w * wlen % P;
            }
        }
    }
    if (invert) {
        int inv_n = mod_inv(n);
        for (int &x : a) x = (ll)x * inv_n % P;
    }
    return a;
}

vector<int> convolute(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int P, int g) {
    int n = 1;
    while (n < (int)(a.size() + b.size() - 1)) n <<= 1;
    vector<int> fa = a, fb = b;
    fa.resize(n); fb.resize(n);
    fa = ntt(fa, false, P, g);
    fb = ntt(fb, false, P, g);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) fa[i] = (ll)fa[i] * fb[i] % P;
    fa = ntt(fa, true, P, g);
    fa.resize(a.size() + b.size() - 1);
    return fa;
}

vector<ll> convoluteSimply(const vector<ll>& a, const vector<ll>& b, int P, int g) {
    int m = max(2, (int)(1 << (32 - __builtin_clz((int)max(a.size(), b.size()) - 1) << 1) << 1));
    vector<int> fa(a.begin(), a.end()), fb(b.begin(), b.end());
    fa.resize(m); fb.resize(m);
    fa = ntt(fa, false, P, g);
    fb = ntt(fb, false, P, g);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) fa[i] = (ll)fa[i] * fb[i] % P;
    fa = ntt(fa, true, P, g);
    vector<ll> res(fa.begin(), fa.end());
    return res;
}

vector<ll> clean(vector<ll> a) {
    int i = (int)a.size() - 1;
    while (i >= 0 && a[i] == 0) i--;
    if (i < 0) return {};
    a.resize(i + 1);
    return a;
}

vector<ll> mulnaive(const vector<ll>& a, const vector<ll>& b) {
    vector<ll> c(a.size() + b.size() - 1, 0);
    ll big = 8LL * mod * mod;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < (int)b.size(); j++) {
            c[i + j] += a[i] * b[j];
            if (c[i + j] >= big) c[i + j] -= big;
        }
    }
    for (ll &x : c) x %= mod;
    return c;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false); cin.tie(0);
    int n, K;
    cin >> n >> K;
    vector<int> d(K);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) cin >> d[i];
    vector<ll> f(20, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
            f[10 + d[i] - d[j]]++;
        }
    }
    n /= 2;
    vector<ll> g = {1};
    for (int D = 17; D >= 0; D--) {
        g = clean(convoluteSimply(g, g, mod, 3));
        if (n & (1 << D)) {
            g = clean(mulnaive(g, f));
        }
    }
    cout << (n * 10 < (int)g.size() ? g[n * 10] : 0) << endl;
    return 0;
}
